subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: marketplace procurement playbook
messages:
From: James R. Nolan <j.nolan@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: MAP + marketplace procurement paths for Acme

Vanessa,

Thanks again for yesterday's call. Procurement at Acme wants a single mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out: (1) steps to buy via AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces, (2) reseller purchase option with CloudBridge, and (3) timeline for PO/DocuSign so we can hit a June 30 go-live.

Can you confirm whether we need different SOW/price sheets for marketplace purchases vs. a reseller order? Also asking for a weekly checkpoint cadence so procurement and legal are comfortable with the timeline.

Attaching our internal procurement checklist separately (not attached here). Please loop in any marketplace contacts on your side.

Best,
James Nolan
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
j.nolan@acme.com

--
No attachments in this message

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: James R. Nolan <j.nolan@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP + marketplace procurement paths for Acme

James — thanks, quick reply and a package to get us moving.

Summary: we'll support both marketplace and reseller flows. Key differences:
- Marketplace purchases (AWS/Azure/GCP): faster procurement for standard pricing and SaaS agreements; requires marketplace listing + marketplace order form; invoicing and rev share handled via marketplace.
- Reseller (CloudBridge): supports consolidated billing, volume discounts, reserved/dedicated capacity clauses; needs separate reseller MSA + reseller ordering form and possible SOW for dedicated capacity.

I've attached a draft MAP (Acme-MAP-v2.pdf) and a simple marketplace procurement flow diagram (marketplace-flow.png). Proposed cadence: weekly MAP checkpoints every Tuesday at 2pm ET starting June 2. If that works, we'll use the MAP to track owners and gating items.

Key ask from Acme: confirm preferred procurement path (marketplace vs reseller) by Jun 9 so we can lock discounting and DocuSign timelines.

Action items I propose now:
- Redwood: produce final pricing schedule for marketplace and reseller (owner: Sergio) — due Jun 4
- Redwood: prepare reseller MSA template for CloudBridge (owner: Karthik) — due Jun 9
- Acme: confirm procurement path (owner: James) — due Jun 9
- Both: weekly MAP checkpoint (owner: Vanessa) — recurring from Jun 2

Attachments: Acme-MAP-v2.pdf (draft), marketplace-flow.png (diagram)

Thanks — I looped in Sergio and Karthik to handle pricing and reseller legal.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
Attachment: Acme-MAP-v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: marketplace-flow.png (image/png)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Internal: pricing options for Acme (internal note)

Forwarding my internal notes to keep the thread in one place. Please treat as internal until we finalize numbers.

Notes:
- Marketplace list pricing: standard SaaS SKU with marketplace rev-share (we should model net to Redwood).
- Reseller path: CloudBridge wants 18% margin; we can offer a partner discount vs. public list to keep net within target ARR metrics.
- Consider a short-term onboarding credit for one month of Dedicated to reduce first-month unit cost (finance ok if capped at $Xk).

Action items (internal):
- Sergio: draft marketplace price schedule and net-revenue model — due Jun 4
- Karthik: prepare reseller MSA skeleton and confirm CloudBridge's legal redlines (intro call scheduled May 29) — due Jun 9
- Marissa: prepare a crisp summary for Acme's procurement team that explains invoice flow and who they pay under each path — due Jun 9

Forwarded message below.

--

Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: marketplace procurement playbook

Hi all — thanks for joining today's checkpoint. Notes below (short and actionable).

Attendees: James Nolan (Acme), Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood), Claire O'Connor (AWS Partner), Sergio Alvarez (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), CloudBridge partnerships (via email).

Meeting summary / status:
- Decision point: Acme is leaning toward AWS Marketplace for initial purchase (self-service order) and reserving reseller (CloudBridge) for multi-year committed capacity. Acme to confirm by Jun 9.
- Marketplace listing: Claire confirmed the listing timeline is ~10 business days once we supply listing metadata and legal contact.
- Reseller MSA: Karthik confirmed he has a skeleton MSA and will send CloudBridge copy by Jun 3.
- Pricing: Sergio provided two slides (marketplace list and proposed reseller net). Draft pricing schedule due Jun 4.

Action items (owners & status):
1) Acme: confirm procurement path (marketplace vs reseller for initial order) — owner: James Nolan — due: 2026-06-09 — status: pending
2) Redwood: final marketplace price schedule and revenue model — owner: Sergio Alvarez — due: 2026-06-04 — status: in progress
3) Redwood: send reseller MSA skeleton to CloudBridge — owner: Karthik Iyer — due: 2026-06-03 — status: in progress
4) Redwood: finalize MAP and circulate final PDF for signatures (DocuSign) — owner: Vanessa Ortiz — due: 2026-06-11 — status: drafting (Acme to confirm path)
5) Redwood/CloudBridge: confirm reseller ordering flow & billing owner — owner: Marissa Cole + CloudBridge Partnerships — due: 2026-06-09 — status: queued

Risks / blockers:
- If Acme waits past Jun 9 to choose, marketplace listing lead time could push procurement past the June 30 window.
- Legal redlines from CloudBridge could affect reseller go-live timing.

Next checkpoint: Tue Jun 9, 2pm ET (tentative). I'll update the MAP in Drive and share the DocuSign envelope link once pricing is final.
